data.narrative:
Hexana is a Seed-stage nuclear energy company founded by Sylvain Nizou and Paul Gauthe, having raised €25M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a nuclear energy sector universe of 11 peers—3 public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private companies including Nano Nuclear Energy, Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, and X-Energy.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable and forms the primary valuation anchor. Using total capital raised of $25M as a base proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage progression yields $62.5M. The Peer-Median method is not applicable; while 6 same-sector peers exist, the nuclear energy universe lacks sufficient density at Hexana's stage and valuation tier to produce a reliable narrow peer set (minimum 3 required; filtered sets yielded 1–2 datapoints).

The triangulated valuation range is $53M (low), $62.5M (median), and $72M (high), derived conservatively from the single applicable method with ±15% sensitivity bounds. Key uncertainties limiting precision include the thin peer set at early stages in nuclear energy and reliance on capital raised as a valuation proxy absent market comparables. A Post-Money Seed valuation near $62M is supported, contingent on confirmation through revenue multiples or investor signaling as Hexana progresses toward Series A.
